# HexPiece 2.8.4

- **Three new moves per fighting style, straight from the show, on C, V and B in combat mode** (they open at style mastery 20, 100
  and 250):
  - **Black Leg:** Party Table Kick Course (a handstand, legs split and spinning, kicking everything round you), Anti-Manner Kick Course
    (onto your hands, both legs driven up to launch them into the sky), Diable Jambe: Premier Hachis (the leg spun until it burns, then a
    storm of blazing kicks).
  - **Six Powers:** Moon Walk (kick off the air: jump again and again in mid-air), Paper Art (limp as paper: for 2 seconds every blow
    and shot aimed at you misses), Six King Gun (both fists pressed into them, a sphere of shock).
  - **Fishman Karate:** Spear Wave (a spear of water thrown through everything in its line), Vagabond Drill (a whirlpool drilled into
    them), Five-Thousand Brick Fist (a fist into the ground, a wave of water knocking back everything round you).
  - **Iron Fist:** Fist of Love (an overhead fist driving them into the ground), Fist Meteor (a cannonball pitched like a fastball),
    Honesty Impact (one straight punch blowing a tunnel of shock through the air).
- Every new move has its own animation (arms and kicks shown in first person), its own 3D effects, and a Haki variant.
- The new keys show in the abilities panel, the logbook and the creation screen, and can be rebound in Controls ("Style move C/V/B").
- Nothing here has been tested in game yet. The build's checks pass, and every animation and effect was rendered and checked off-game.
